fact: The Deputy Minister in The Presidency told the Portfolio Committee that the Statistics Amendment Act, No. 29 of 2024, was proclaimed for implementation on 1 October 2025, strengthening coordination of statistical production across government.

A parliamentary committee report of 23 June 2026 records Stats SA briefing it on 28 April 2026 on its proposed amendment of the Statistics Act (No. 6 of 1999), so the 1999 Act is the law in force, and lists rolling out amendments under Act No. 29 of 2024 as a 2026 priority.

This document is the text of the Statistics Amendment Act, 2024 (Act 29 of 2024), which amends the Statistics Act, 1999; the President assented on 10 December 2024 and it was published in Government Gazette 51805 on 20 December 2024.

This document is the text of the Statistics Act, 1999 (Act 6 of 1999), published in Government Gazette 19957 on 21 April 1999 after presidential assent; it repeals the Statistics Act, 1976 and the earlier homeland statistics Acts.

Statistics South Africa's CPS-HSPR frame update page cites Sections 17 and 18 of the Statistics Act No. 06 of 1999 as the current legal guarantee of respondent confidentiality and the penalty for an official who divulges information.
